closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, protein, and easy to fit into familiar meals, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin A, low magnesium, and saturated fat. It is good for practical meals, muscles, and immune support because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, protein still gives it a muscle-support angle, and vitamin A gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
